import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import values = "./values_fields.qui"

class RuntimeError(lexer.Position position, string message)

string text_character(int code)
    if code == 10
        return NL
    const printable := " !{DQ}#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"
    return printable[code - 32]

string digits_text(int amount, int base)
    alphabet := "0123456789abcdef"
    result := ""
    while amount > 0 or result == ""
        result = alphabet[amount % base] + result
        amount /= base
    return result

string | RuntimeError format(const values.Value[] arguments, const lexer.Position position)
    specification := arguments[0].string_value()
    result := ""
    cursor := 0
    argument_index := 1
    while cursor < int(#specification)
        if specification[cursor] != "%"
            result += specification[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            continue
        cursor += 1
        if cursor < int(#specification) and specification[cursor] == "%"
            result += "%"
            cursor += 1
            continue
        left := false
        zero := false
        while cursor < int(#specification) and (specification[cursor] == "-" or specification[cursor] == "0")
            left = left or specification[cursor] == "-"
            zero = zero or specification[cursor] == "0"
            cursor += 1
        start := cursor
        while cursor < int(#specification) and lexer.digit(specification[cursor])
            cursor += 1
        int width := if cursor == start then 0 else int(specification[start:<cursor])
        precision := -1
        if cursor < int(#specification) and specification[cursor] == "."
            cursor += 1
            start = cursor
            while cursor < int(#specification) and lexer.digit(specification[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            precision = if cursor == start then 0 else int(specification[start:<cursor])
        if cursor == int(#specification) or not "discxo".contains(specification[cursor])
            return RuntimeError(position, "invalid format")
        conversion := specification[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if argument_index == int(#arguments)
            return RuntimeError(position, "not enough arguments")
        value := arguments[argument_index]
        argument_index += 1
        numeric := "dixo".contains(conversion)
        body := ""
        if numeric
            amount := value.number()
            magnitude := if amount < 0 then -amount else amount
            digits := digits_text(magnitude, if conversion == "x" then 16 elif conversion == "o" then 8 else 10)
            if precision >= 0
                if precision == 0 and amount == 0
                    digits = ""
                while int(#digits) < precision
                    digits = "0" + digits
            body = (if amount < 0 then "-" else "") + digits
        elif conversion == "s"
            body = value.string_value()
            if precision >= 0 and precision < int(#body)
                body = body[0:<precision]
        elif value.kind == "number" or value.kind == "numeric"
            code := value.number()
            if code != 10 and (code < 32 or code > 126)
                return RuntimeError(position, "invalid character code")
            body = text_character(code)
        else
            text := value.string_value()
            body = if text == "" then "" else text[0]
        padding := width - int(#body)
        if padding > 0
            if left
                body += " " * nat(padding)
            elif numeric and zero and precision < 0
                string zeros := "0" * nat(padding)
                body = if body.starts_with("-") then "-" + zeros + body[1:<int(#body)] else zeros + body
            else
                body = " " * nat(padding) + body
        result += body
    return result

values.Value | RuntimeError scalar(string name, const values.Value[] arguments, const lexer.Position position)
    if name == "substr"
        text := arguments[0].string_value()
        original := arguments[1].number()
        start := if original < 1 then 1 else original
        finish := if #arguments == 3 then original + arguments[2].number() else int(#text) + 1
        if finish > int(#text) + 1
            finish = int(#text) + 1
        return values.Value("string", if finish > start then text[start - 1:<finish - 1] else "")
    if name == "index"
        text := arguments[0].string_value()
        target := arguments[1].string_value()
        if target == ""
            return values.Value("number", amount = 0)
        match text.find(target)
            nat index
                return values.Value("number", amount = int(index) + 1)
            none
                return values.Value("number", amount = 0)
    if name == "toupper" or name == "tolower"
        text := arguments[0].string_value()
        result := ""
        for: index < int(#text)
            character := text[index]
            int code := character.codepoints()[0]
            if name == "toupper" and character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122
                result += text_character(code - 32)
            elif name == "tolower" and character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90
                result += text_character(code + 32)
            else
                result += character
        return values.Value("string", result)
    if name == "int"
        return values.Value("number", amount = arguments[0].number())
    match format(arguments, position)
        string text
            return values.Value("string", text)
        RuntimeError problem
            return problem

class Position(int line, int column)
    string text()
        return "{line}:{column}"

class Token(string kind, string text, string value, Position position)
class Result(Token[] tokens, Position | none problem)

bool letter(string character)
    return (character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122)

bool digit(string character)
    return character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

bool has(const string[] items, string sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

Result lex(string source)
    Position[] positions := []
    line_number := 1
    column := 1
    for: index < int(#source)
        positions = positions.append(Position(line_number, column))
        if source[index] == NL
            line_number += 1
            column = 1
        else
            column += 1
    positions = positions.append(Position(line_number, 1))
    keywords := ["BEGIN", "END", "function", "if", "else", "while", "for", "do", "break", "continue", "next", "exit", "return", "delete", "in", "getline", "print", "printf"]
    builtins := ["length", "substr", "index", "split", "sprintf", "toupper", "tolower", "close", "int"]
    symbols := ["+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "^=", "==", "<=", ">=", "!=", "++", "--", "&&", "||", ">>"]
    Token[] tokens := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#source)
        character := source[cursor]
        if character == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        if character == "\" and cursor + 1 < int(#source) and source[cursor + 1] == NL
            cursor += 2
            continue
        if character == "#"
            while cursor < int(#source) and source[cursor] != NL
                cursor += 1
            continue
        start := cursor
        kind := "symbol"
        value := ""
        if character == NL
            cursor += 1
            kind = "newline"
        elif digit(character)
            while cursor < int(#source) and digit(source[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            kind = "number"
        elif letter(character) or character == "_"
            while cursor < int(#source) and (letter(source[cursor]) or digit(source[cursor]) or source[cursor] == "_")
                cursor += 1
            word := source[start:<cursor]
            kind = if has(keywords, word) then "keyword" elif has(builtins, word) then "builtin" elif cursor < int(#source) and source[cursor] == "(" then "function" else "name"
        elif character == DQ
            cursor += 1
            closed := false
            while cursor < int(#source)
                if source[cursor] == NL
                    return Result([], positions[start])
                if source[cursor] == DQ
                    cursor += 1
                    closed = true
                    break
                if source[cursor] == "\"
                    slash := cursor
                    cursor += 1
                    if cursor == int(#source)
                        return Result([], positions[start])
                    escaped := source[cursor]
                    if escaped == "n"
                        value += NL
                    elif escaped == "t"
                        value += HT
                    elif escaped == "\" or escaped == DQ or escaped == "/"
                        value += escaped
                    else
                        return Result([], positions[slash])
                    cursor += 1
                else
                    value += source[cursor]
                    cursor += 1
            if not closed
                return Result([], positions[start])
            kind = "string"
        elif cursor + 1 < int(#source) and has(symbols, source[cursor:<cursor + 2])
            cursor += 2
        elif "+-*/%^!><?:=()[]{{}},;$".contains(character)
            cursor += 1
        else
            return Result([], positions[cursor])
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, source[start:<cursor], value, positions[start]))
    return Result(tokens.append(Token("end", "", "", positions[int(#source)])), none)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"
import values = "./values_fields.qui"
import builtins = "./builtins.qui"
import streams = "./streams.qui"

class StaticError(lexer.Position position, int priority, string message)
class NameUse(string key, string name, lexer.Position position)
class Link(string first, string second)
class Preparation(globals := ["FILENAME", "FNR", "FS", "NF", "NR", "OFS", "ORS", "SUBSEP"], string[] arrays := [], NameUse[] uses := [], functions := map<string, int>(), lines := map<int, int>(), StaticError | none problem := none)
class Binding(value := values.Value(), array_index := -1)
class Location(string kind, name := "", frame := -1, array_index := -1, key := "", field := 0)
class Context(parser.Program program, Preparation preparation, streams.Arguments arguments, fields := values.Fields(), io := streams.State(), globals := map<string, Binding>(), map<string, Binding>[] frames := [], map<string, values.Value>[] arrays := [], operand := 0, current_file := -1, string[] current_lines := [], current_position := 0, phase := "BEGIN", status := 0, flow := "", returned := values.Value(), builtins.RuntimeError | none problem := none, int[] rule_counts := [], bool[] ranges := [], int[] calls := [], int[] active := [], int[] depths := [])

string[] add_name(string[] names, string name)
    return if lexer.has(names, name) then names else names.append(name)

string scoped_key(const parser.Program program, int scope, string name)
    if scope >= 0
        for parameter := program.functions[scope].parameters[]
            if parameter.name == name
                return "{scope}:{name}"
    return "global:{name}"

void use_name(Preparation &preparation, const parser.Program program, int scope, string name, const lexer.Position position, bool array_name)
    key := scoped_key(program, scope, name)
    if key.starts_with("global:")
        preparation.globals = add_name(preparation.globals, name)
    if array_name
        preparation.arrays = add_name(preparation.arrays, key)
    preparation.uses = preparation.uses.append(NameUse(key, name, position))

bool earlier(const StaticError first, const StaticError second)
    return first.position.line < second.position.line or (first.position.line == second.position.line and (first.position.column < second.position.column or (first.position.column == second.position.column and first.priority < second.priority)))

void static_error(Preparation &preparation, StaticError candidate)
    match preparation.problem
        StaticError previous
            if earlier(candidate, previous)
                preparation.problem = candidate
        none
            preparation.problem = candidate

Preparation prepare(const parser.Program program)
    result := Preparation()
    for: index < int(#program.functions)
        parser.Function definition := program.functions[index]
        if result.functions.has(definition.name)
            static_error(&result, StaticError(definition.position, 0, "function {definition.name} redefined"))
        else
            .result.functions.set(definition.name, index)
        string[] seen := []
        for parameter := definition.parameters[]
            if lexer.has(seen, parameter.name)
                static_error(&result, StaticError(parameter.position, 1, "duplicate parameter {parameter.name}"))
            seen = seen.append(parameter.name)
            result.uses = result.uses.append(NameUse("{index}:{parameter.name}", parameter.name, parameter.position))
    for node := program.expressions[]
        if node.kind == "name" or node.kind == "index"
            use_name(&result, program, node.scope, node.text, node.position, node.kind == "index")
        elif node.kind == "member"
            use_name(&result, program, node.scope, node.text, node.name_position, true)
        elif node.kind == "call" and node.flag and node.text == "split"
            parser.Expr argument := program.expressions[node.children[1]]
            result.arrays = add_name(result.arrays, scoped_key(program, node.scope, argument.text))
    for node := program.statements[]
        if node.kind != "block" and node.kind != "empty"
            .result.lines.set(node.position.line, 0)
        if node.kind == "delete"
            use_name(&result, program, node.scope, node.name, node.name_position, true)
        elif node.kind == "forin"
            use_name(&result, program, node.scope, node.name, node.name_position, false)
            use_name(&result, program, node.scope, node.array_name, node.array_position, true)
    for use := result.uses[]
        if result.functions.has(use.name)
            static_error(&result, StaticError(use.position, 2, "function {use.name} used as variable"))
    Link[] links := []
    for node := program.expressions[]
        if node.kind != "call" or node.flag
            continue
        function_index := -1
        match result.functions.get(node.text)
            int found
                function_index = found
            none
                static_error(&result, StaticError(node.position, 3, "undefined function {node.text}"))
                continue
        parser.Function definition := program.functions[function_index]
        if #node.children > #definition.parameters
            static_error(&result, StaticError(node.position, 4, "too many arguments to {node.text}"))
        count := if #node.children < #definition.parameters then int(#node.children) else int(#definition.parameters)
        for: index < count
            parser.Expr argument := program.expressions[node.children[index]]
            if argument.kind == "name"
                links = links.append(Link(scoped_key(program, node.scope, argument.text), "{function_index}:{definition.parameters[index].name}"))
    while true
        changed := false
        for link := links[]
            if lexer.has(result.arrays, link.first) or lexer.has(result.arrays, link.second)
                if not lexer.has(result.arrays, link.first)
                    result.arrays = result.arrays.append(link.first)
                    changed = true
                if not lexer.has(result.arrays, link.second)
                    result.arrays = result.arrays.append(link.second)
                    changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    return result

int new_array(Context &context)
    context.arrays = context.arrays.append(map<string, values.Value>())
    return int(#context.arrays) - 1

int frame_for(const Context context, string name)
    index := int(#context.frames) - 1
    return if index >= 0 and context.frames[index].has(name) then index else -1

Binding binding(const Context context, int frame, string name)
    cells := if frame < 0 then context.globals else context.frames[frame]
    match cells.get(name)
        Binding found
            return found
        none
            return Binding()

values.Value variable_value(const Context context, int frame, string name)
    if frame < 0 and name == "NF"
        return values.Value("number", amount = int(#context.fields.values))
    return binding(context, frame, name).value

values.Value global_value(const Context context, string name)
    return variable_value(context, -1, name)

int array_for(const Context context, string name)
    return binding(context, frame_for(context, name), name).array_index

void put_global(Context &context, string name, values.Value value)
    .context.globals.set(name, Binding(value))
    context.preparation.globals = add_name(context.preparation.globals, name)

void runtime_error(Context &context, const lexer.Position position, string message)
    if context.flow == ""
        context.problem = builtins.RuntimeError(position, message)
        context.flow = "error"

values.Value evaluate(Context &context, int index);
void execute_statement(Context &context, int index);

string subscript(Context &context, const int[] expressions)
    string[] parts := []
    for index := expressions[]
        value := evaluate(&context, index)
        if context.flow != ""
            return ""
        parts = parts.append(value.string_value())
    return parts.join(global_value(context, "SUBSEP").string_value())

Location locate(Context &context, int index)
    parser.Expr node := context.program.expressions[index]
    if node.kind == "name"
        return Location("variable", node.text, frame_for(context, node.text))
    if node.kind == "index"
        key := subscript(&context, node.children)
        return Location("element", array_index = array_for(context, node.text), key = key)
    value := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
    field_index := value.number()
    if context.flow == "" and field_index < 0
        runtime_error(&context, node.position, "negative field index")
    return Location("field", field = field_index)

values.Value read_location(Context &context, const Location location)
    if context.flow != ""
        return values.Value()
    if location.kind == "variable"
        return variable_value(context, location.frame, location.name)
    if location.kind == "field"
        return values.get_field(context.fields, location.field)
    match context.arrays[location.array_index].get(location.key)
        values.Value found
            return found
        none
            value := values.Value()
            .context.arrays[location.array_index].set(location.key, value)
            return value

values.Value store(Context &context, const Location location, const values.Value value, const lexer.Position position)
    if context.flow != ""
        return values.Value()
    if location.kind == "field"
        fs := global_value(context, "FS").string_value()
        ofs := global_value(context, "OFS").string_value()
        values.assign_field(&context.fields, location.field, value, fs, ofs)
    elif location.kind == "element"
        .context.arrays[location.array_index].set(location.key, value)
    elif location.frame < 0 and location.name == "NF"
        count := value.number()
        if count < 0
            runtime_error(&context, position, "negative NF")
            return values.Value()
        ofs := global_value(context, "OFS").string_value()
        values.change_nf(&context.fields, count, ofs)
    elif location.frame >= 0
        .context.frames[location.frame].set(location.name, Binding(value))
    else
        put_global(&context, location.name, value)
    return read_location(&context, location)

values.Value arithmetic(Context &context, string operation, int first, int second, const lexer.Position position)
    if context.flow != ""
        return values.Value()
    if (operation == "/" or operation == "%") and second == 0
        runtime_error(&context, position, "division by zero")
        return values.Value()
    if operation == "^" and second < 0
        runtime_error(&context, position, "negative exponent")
        return values.Value()
    amount := 0
    if operation == "+"
        amount = first + second
    elif operation == "-"
        amount = first - second
    elif operation == "*"
        amount = first * second
    elif operation == "/"
        amount = first / second
    elif operation == "%"
        amount = first % second
    else
        amount = 1
        base := first
        exponent := second
        while exponent > 0
            if exponent % 2 == 1
                amount *= base
            exponent /= 2
            if exponent > 0
                base *= base
    return values.Value("number", amount = amount)

string | none next_record(Context &context)
    if context.phase == "END" or context.flow != ""
        return none
    while true
        if context.current_file >= 0 and context.current_position < int(#context.current_lines)
            line := context.current_lines[context.current_position]
            context.current_position += 1
            context.arguments.files[context.current_file].records += 1
            nr := global_value(context, "NR").number() + 1
            fnr := global_value(context, "FNR").number() + 1
            put_global(&context, "NR", values.Value("number", amount = nr))
            put_global(&context, "FNR", values.Value("number", amount = fnr))
            return line
        if context.operand == int(#context.arguments.operands)
            return none
        streams.Operand operand := context.arguments.operands[context.operand]
        context.operand += 1
        if operand.kind == "assignment"
            put_global(&context, operand.name, values.input_value(operand.value))
        else
            put_global(&context, "FILENAME", values.Value("string", operand.name))
            put_global(&context, "FNR", values.Value("number"))
            context.current_file = operand.file_index
            context.current_position = 0
            match streams.read_data(operand.name)
                string[] lines
                    context.current_lines = lines
                none
                    context.current_lines = []

values.Value call_builtin(Context &context, const parser.Expr node)
    if node.text == "length"
        if #node.children == 0
            return values.Value("number", amount = int(#context.fields.record.string_value()))
        parser.Expr argument := context.program.expressions[node.children[0]]
        if argument.kind == "name"
            array_index := array_for(context, argument.text)
            if array_index >= 0
                return values.Value("number", amount = int(context.arrays[array_index].size()))
        value := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
        return values.Value("number", amount = int(#value.string_value()))
    if node.text == "split"
        first := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
        separator := global_value(context, "FS").string_value()
        if #node.children == 3
            third := evaluate(&context, node.children[2])
            separator = third.string_value()
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        string name := context.program.expressions[node.children[1]].text
        array_index := array_for(context, name)
        pieces := values.split_text(first.string_value(), separator)
        context.arrays[array_index] = map<string, values.Value>()
        for: index < int(#pieces)
            .context.arrays[array_index].set("{index + 1}", values.input_value(pieces[index]))
        return values.Value("number", amount = int(#pieces))
    values.Value[] arguments := []
    for index := node.children[]
        arguments = arguments.append(evaluate(&context, index))
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
    if node.text == "close"
        result := streams.close(&context.io, arguments[0].string_value())
        return values.Value("number", amount = result)
    match builtins.scalar(node.text, arguments, node.position)
        values.Value value
            return value
        builtins.RuntimeError problem
            runtime_error(&context, problem.position, problem.message)
            return values.Value()

values.Value call_function(Context &context, const parser.Expr node)
    index := -1
    match context.preparation.functions.get(node.text)
        int found
            index = found
        none
            return values.Value()
    parser.Function definition := context.program.functions[index]
    map<string, Binding> frame
    for: parameter_index < int(#definition.parameters)
        string name := definition.parameters[parameter_index].name
        cell := Binding()
        if lexer.has(context.preparation.arrays, "{index}:{name}")
            if parameter_index < int(#node.children)
                string actual_name := context.program.expressions[node.children[parameter_index]].text
                cell.array_index = array_for(context, actual_name)
            else
                cell.array_index = new_array(&context)
        elif parameter_index < int(#node.children)
            cell.value = evaluate(&context, node.children[parameter_index])
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        .frame.set(name, cell)
    context.calls[index] += 1
    context.active[index] += 1
    if context.active[index] > context.depths[index]
        context.depths[index] = context.active[index]
    context.frames = context.frames.append(frame)
    execute_statement(&context, definition.body)
    context.frames = context.frames[0:<int(#context.frames) - 1]
    context.active[index] -= 1
    if context.flow == "return"
        result := context.returned
        context.flow = ""
        context.returned = values.Value()
        return result
    return values.Value()

values.Value evaluate(Context &context, int index)
    if context.flow != "" or index < 0
        return values.Value()
    parser.Expr node := context.program.expressions[index]
    if node.kind == "number"
        return values.Value("number", amount = node.amount)
    if node.kind == "string"
        return values.Value("string", node.text)
    if node.kind == "name" or node.kind == "index" or node.kind == "field"
        location := locate(&context, index)
        return read_location(&context, location)
    if node.kind == "parentheses"
        return evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
    if node.kind == "unary"
        value := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
        amount := if node.text == "-" then -value.number() elif node.text == "+" then value.number() elif value.truth() then 0 else 1
        return values.Value("number", amount = amount)
    if node.kind == "binary"
        first := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        if node.text == "||" and first.truth()
            return values.Value("number", amount = 1)
        if node.text == "&&" and not first.truth()
            return values.Value("number", amount = 0)
        second := evaluate(&context, node.children[1])
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        if node.text == "||" or node.text == "&&"
            return values.Value("number", amount = if second.truth() then 1 else 0)
        if node.text == "concat"
            return values.Value("string", first.string_value() + second.string_value())
        if lexer.has(["<", "<=", "==", "!=", ">=", ">"], node.text)
            order := values.compare(first, second)
            result := if node.text == "<" then order < 0 elif node.text == "<=" then order <= 0 elif node.text == "==" then order == 0 elif node.text == "!=" then order != 0 elif node.text == ">=" then order >= 0 else order > 0
            return values.Value("number", amount = if result then 1 else 0)
        return arithmetic(&context, node.text, first.number(), second.number(), node.position)
    if node.kind == "assignment"
        location := locate(&context, node.children[0])
        right := evaluate(&context, node.children[1])
        value := right
        if node.text != "="
            left := read_location(&context, location)
            value = arithmetic(&context, node.text[0], left.number(), right.number(), node.position)
        return store(&context, location, value, node.position)
    if node.kind == "increment"
        location := locate(&context, node.children[0])
        previous := read_location(&context, location)
        amount := previous.number()
        ignored := store(&context, location, values.Value("number", amount = amount + node.amount), node.position)
        return values.Value("number", amount = if node.flag then amount + node.amount else amount)
    if node.kind == "conditional"
        condition := evaluate(&context, node.children[0])
        return evaluate(&context, node.children[if condition.truth() then 1 else 2])
    if node.kind == "member"
        key := subscript(&context, node.children)
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        array_index := array_for(context, node.text)
        return values.Value("number", amount = if context.arrays[array_index].has(key) then 1 else 0)
    if node.kind == "call"
        return if node.flag then call_builtin(&context, node) else call_function(&context, node)
    line := streams.Line(0)
    if node.children[1] >= 0
        name := evaluate(&context, node.children[1])
        if context.flow != ""
            return values.Value()
        line = streams.getline(&context.io, name.string_value())
    else
        match next_record(&context)
            string found
                line = streams.Line(1, found)
            none
                line = streams.Line(0)
    if line.status == 1
        if node.children[0] >= 0
            location := locate(&context, node.children[0])
            ignored := store(&context, location, values.input_value(line.text), node.position)
        else
            fs := global_value(context, "FS").string_value()
            values.set_record(&context.fields, line.text, fs)
    return values.Value("number", amount = line.status)

void output_statement(Context &context, const parser.Stmt node)
    values.Value[] arguments := []
    for index := node.expressions[]
        arguments = arguments.append(evaluate(&context, index))
        if context.flow != ""
            return
    text := ""
    if node.formatted
        match builtins.format(arguments, node.position)
            string found
                text = found
            builtins.RuntimeError problem
                runtime_error(&context, problem.position, problem.message)
                return
    else
        if #arguments == 0
            arguments = [context.fields.record]
        string[] pieces := []
        for argument := arguments[]
            pieces = pieces.append(argument.string_value())
        text = pieces.join(global_value(context, "OFS").string_value()) + global_value(context, "ORS").string_value()
    string | none name := none
    if node.destination >= 0
        destination := evaluate(&context, node.destination)
        if context.flow != ""
            return
        target := destination.string_value()
        if not streams.valid_file(target) or target == "stdout.txt" or target == "stats.txt"
            runtime_error(&context, node.redirect_position, "invalid output file name")
            return
        name = target
    streams.output(&context.io, name, node.redirect == ">>", text)

bool execute_loop_body(Context &context, int body)
    execute_statement(&context, body)
    if context.flow == "break"
        context.flow = ""
        return false
    if context.flow == "continue"
        context.flow = ""
    return context.flow == ""

void execute_statement(Context &context, int index)
    if context.flow != "" or index < 0
        return
    parser.Stmt node := context.program.statements[index]
    if node.kind != "block" and node.kind != "empty"
        count := 0
        match context.preparation.lines.get(node.position.line)
            int found
                count = found
            none
                count = 0
        .context.preparation.lines.set(node.position.line, count + 1)
    if node.kind == "block"
        for child := node.children[]
            execute_statement(&context, child)
            if context.flow != ""
                break
    elif node.kind == "expression"
        ignored := evaluate(&context, node.expressions[0])
    elif node.kind == "if"
        condition := evaluate(&context, node.expressions[0])
        execute_statement(&context, node.children[if condition.truth() then 0 else 1])
    elif node.kind == "while" or node.kind == "do" or node.kind == "for"
        if node.kind == "for"
            ignored := evaluate(&context, node.expressions[0])
        first_iteration := true
        while context.flow == ""
            repeat := true
            if node.kind == "while" or (node.kind == "do" and not first_iteration) or (node.kind == "for" and node.expressions[1] >= 0)
                condition_index := node.expressions[if node.kind == "for" then 1 else 0]
                condition := evaluate(&context, condition_index)
                repeat = condition.truth()
            if not repeat or context.flow != ""
                break
            first_iteration = false
            if not execute_loop_body(&context, node.children[0])
                break
            if node.kind == "for"
                ignored := evaluate(&context, node.expressions[2])
    elif node.kind == "forin"
        array_index := array_for(context, node.array_name)
        keys := context.arrays[array_index].keys()
        for key := values.key_order(keys)[]
            location := Location("variable", node.name, frame_for(context, node.name))
            ignored := store(&context, location, values.input_value(key), node.name_position)
            if not execute_loop_body(&context, node.children[0])
                break
    elif node.kind == "output"
        output_statement(&context, node)
    elif node.kind == "delete"
        key := if node.formatted then subscript(&context, node.expressions) else ""
        if context.flow != ""
            return
        array_index := array_for(context, node.name)
        if node.formatted
            .context.arrays[array_index].remove(key)
        else
            context.arrays[array_index] = map<string, values.Value>()
    elif node.kind == "next"
        if context.phase == "BEGIN" or context.phase == "END"
            runtime_error(&context, node.position, "next used in BEGIN or END")
        else
            context.flow = "next"
    elif node.kind == "break" or node.kind == "continue"
        context.flow = node.kind
    elif node.kind == "return" or node.kind == "exit"
        value := evaluate(&context, node.expressions[0])
        if context.flow != ""
            return
        if node.kind == "exit" and node.expressions[0] >= 0
            context.status = value.number()
        context.returned = value
        context.flow = node.kind

bool test_rule(Context &context, const parser.Rule rule, int index)
    if rule.kind == "all"
        return true
    if rule.kind == "range"
        if not context.ranges[index]
            start := evaluate(&context, rule.start)
            if context.flow != ""
                return false
            if start.truth()
                context.ranges[index] = true
        matched := context.ranges[index]
        if matched
            finish := evaluate(&context, rule.finish)
            if context.flow == "" and finish.truth()
                context.ranges[index] = false
        return matched
    result := evaluate(&context, rule.start)
    return result.truth()

void execute_program(Context &context)
    for option := context.arguments.options[]
        put_global(&context, option.name, values.input_value(option.value))
    for: index < int(#context.program.rules)
        parser.Rule rule := context.program.rules[index]
        if rule.kind == "BEGIN"
            context.rule_counts[index] += 1
            execute_statement(&context, rule.action)
            if context.flow != ""
                break
    if context.flow == "error"
        return
    exiting := context.flow == "exit"
    context.flow = ""
    context.phase = "rules"
    read_input := false
    for rule := context.program.rules[]
        read_input = read_input or rule.kind != "BEGIN"
    if not exiting and read_input
        while true
            string | none next_line := next_record(&context)
            record := ""
            obtained := false
            match next_line
                string line
                    record = line
                    obtained = true
                none
                    obtained = false
            if not obtained
                break
            fs := global_value(context, "FS").string_value()
            values.set_record(&context.fields, record, fs)
            for: index < int(#context.program.rules)
                parser.Rule rule := context.program.rules[index]
                if rule.kind == "BEGIN" or rule.kind == "END"
                    continue
                matched := test_rule(&context, rule, index)
                if context.flow == "" and matched
                    context.rule_counts[index] += 1
                    if rule.action >= 0
                        execute_statement(&context, rule.action)
                    else
                        string text := context.fields.record.string_value() + global_value(context, "ORS").string_value()
                        streams.output(&context.io, none, false, text)
                if context.flow != ""
                    break
            if context.flow == "next"
                context.flow = ""
                continue
            if context.flow != ""
                break
    if context.flow == "error"
        return
    context.flow = ""
    context.phase = "END"
    for: index < int(#context.program.rules)
        parser.Rule rule := context.program.rules[index]
        if rule.kind == "END"
            context.rule_counts[index] += 1
            execute_statement(&context, rule.action)
            if context.flow != ""
                break

Context initialize(const parser.Program program, const Preparation preparation, const streams.Arguments arguments)
    context := Context(program, preparation, arguments)
    for name := preparation.globals[]
        cell := Binding()
        if lexer.has(preparation.arrays, "global:{name}")
            cell.array_index = new_array(&context)
        .context.globals.set(name, cell)
    bin separator_bits := bin("00011100")
    string separator := string.from_utf8(separator_bits)
    put_global(&context, "FS", values.Value("string", " "))
    put_global(&context, "OFS", values.Value("string", " "))
    put_global(&context, "ORS", values.Value("string", NL))
    put_global(&context, "SUBSEP", values.Value("string", separator))
    put_global(&context, "NR", values.Value("number"))
    put_global(&context, "FNR", values.Value("number"))
    put_global(&context, "FILENAME", values.Value("string"))
    context.rule_counts = array(#program.rules, fill = 0)
    context.ranges = array(#program.rules, fill = false)
    context.calls = array(#program.functions, fill = 0)
    context.active = array(#program.functions, fill = 0)
    context.depths = array(#program.functions, fill = 0)
    return context

void save_stats(const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    writer1 := file.write("output/stats.txt")
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void failure(string status)
    save_stats([status])
    writer2 := file.write("output/stdout.txt")
    .writer2("")

void report(const Context context)
    streams.save(context.io)
    status := "status: exit {context.status}"
    match context.problem
        builtins.RuntimeError problem
            status = "status: runtime error at {problem.position.text()}: {problem.message}"
        none
            status = status
    lines := [status, "[inputs]"]
    for input_file := context.arguments.files[]
        lines = lines.append("{input_file.name} records={input_file.records}")
    lines = lines.append("[getline]")
    for input_file := context.io.inputs[]
        lines = lines.append(if input_file.opened then "{input_file.name} reads={input_file.reads}" else "{input_file.name} missing")
    lines = lines.append("[rules]")
    for: index < int(#context.program.rules)
        parser.Rule rule := context.program.rules[index]
        lines = lines.append("{rule.position.text()} {rule.kind} count={context.rule_counts[index]}")
    lines = lines.append("[functions]")
    for: index < int(#context.program.functions)
        parser.Function definition := context.program.functions[index]
        lines = lines.append("{definition.name} calls={context.calls[index]} depth={context.depths[index]}")
    lines = lines.concat(["[outputs]", "stdout.txt writes={context.io.writes} bytes={#context.io.stdout}"])
    for output_file := context.io.outputs[]
        lines = lines.append("{output_file.name} writes={output_file.writes} bytes={#output_file.text}")
    lines = lines.append("[lines]")
    line_numbers := context.preparation.lines.keys()
    for line_number := line_numbers.sorted()[]
        match context.preparation.lines.get(line_number)
            int count
                lines = lines.append("{line_number} count={count}")
            none
                continue
    lines = lines.append("[globals]")
    for name := context.preparation.globals.sorted()[]
        cell := binding(context, -1, name)
        display := if cell.array_index >= 0 then "array ({context.arrays[cell.array_index].size()})" else global_value(context, name).display()
        lines = lines.append("{name} = {display}")
    save_stats(lines)

void run_program()
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/program.awk"))
    tokens := lexer.lex(source)
    match tokens.problem
        lexer.Position position
            failure("status: syntax error at {position.text()}")
            return
        none
            source = source
    program := parser.parse(tokens.tokens)
    match program.problem
        lexer.Position position
            failure("status: syntax error at {position.text()}")
            return
        none
            source = source
    preparation := prepare(program)
    match preparation.problem
        StaticError problem
            failure("status: error at {problem.position.text()}: {problem.message}")
            return
        none
            source = source
    string arguments_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/args.txt"))
    context := initialize(program, preparation, streams.arguments(arguments_text))
    execute_program(&context)
    report(context)

if main
    run_program()

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class Expr(string kind, lexer.Position position, int scope, text := "", int[] children := [], amount := 0, flag := false, name_position := lexer.Position(0, 0))
    bool lvalue()
        return kind == "name" or kind == "index" or kind == "field"

class Stmt(string kind, lexer.Position position, int scope, int[] expressions := [], int[] children := [], name := "", array_name := "", name_position := lexer.Position(0, 0), array_position := lexer.Position(0, 0), formatted := false, redirect := "", destination := -1, redirect_position := lexer.Position(0, 0))
class Parameter(string name, lexer.Position position)
class Function(string name, lexer.Position position, Parameter[] parameters, int body)
class Rule(string kind, lexer.Position position, start := -1, finish := -1, action := -1)
class Program(Expr[] expressions := [], Stmt[] statements := [], Rule[] rules := [], Function[] functions := [], lexer.Position | none problem := none)
class Parser(lexer.Token[] tokens, program := Program(), cursor := 0, scope := -1, special := false, loops := 0, failed := false)

lexer.Token peek(const Parser parser)
    return parser.tokens[parser.cursor]

string text(const Parser parser)
    return peek(parser).text

void fail(Parser &parser, const lexer.Position position)
    if not parser.failed
        parser.failed = true
        parser.program.problem = position

lexer.Token take(Parser &parser)
    token := peek(parser)
    if not parser.failed and token.kind != "end"
        parser.cursor += 1
    return token

lexer.Token expect(Parser &parser, string spelling)
    if text(parser) != spelling or peek(parser).kind == "end"
        fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
    return take(&parser)

lexer.Token read_name(Parser &parser)
    if peek(parser).kind != "name"
        fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
    return take(&parser)

void newlines(Parser &parser)
    while not parser.failed and peek(parser).kind == "newline"
        ignored := take(&parser)

void terminator(Parser &parser)
    if text(parser) == ";" or peek(parser).kind == "newline"
        ignored := take(&parser)
    elif text(parser) != "}}"
        fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)

int add_expr(Parser &parser, Expr node)
    parser.program.expressions = parser.program.expressions.append(node)
    return int(#parser.program.expressions) - 1

int add_stmt(Parser &parser, Stmt node)
    parser.program.statements = parser.program.statements.append(node)
    return int(#parser.program.statements) - 1

int parse_expression(Parser &parser, suppress := false);
int parse_binary(Parser &parser, int minimum, bool suppress);
int parse_atom(Parser &parser, bool suppress);
int parse_statement(Parser &parser);

int[] expression_list(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    result := [parse_expression(&parser, suppress)]
    while not parser.failed and text(parser) == ","
        ignored := take(&parser)
        newlines(&parser)
        result = result.append(parse_expression(&parser, suppress))
    return result

int parse_lvalue(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    if peek(parser).kind != "name" and text(parser) != "$"
        fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
    return parse_atom(&parser, suppress)

int parse_prefix(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    token := take(&parser)
    child := parse_lvalue(&parser, suppress)
    return add_expr(&parser, Expr("increment", token.position, parser.scope, children = [child], amount = if token.text == "++" then 1 else -1, flag = true))

int parse_atom(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    token := peek(parser)
    if parser.failed
        return -1
    if token.kind == "number" or token.kind == "string"
        ignored := take(&parser)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr(token.kind, token.position, parser.scope, token.value, amount = if token.kind == "number" then int(token.text) else 0))
    if token.kind == "name"
        ignored := take(&parser)
        if text(parser) == "["
            ignored = take(&parser)
            indices := expression_list(&parser, false)
            ignored = expect(&parser, "]")
            return add_expr(&parser, Expr("index", token.position, parser.scope, token.text, indices))
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("name", token.position, parser.scope, token.text))
    if token.kind == "function" or token.kind == "builtin"
        ignored := take(&parser)
        builtin := token.kind == "builtin"
        int[] arguments := []
        if text(parser) == "("
            ignored = take(&parser)
            if text(parser) != ")"
                arguments = expression_list(&parser, false)
            ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
        elif not builtin or token.text != "length"
            fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
        if not parser.failed and builtin
            count := int(#arguments)
            valid := false
            if token.text == "length"
                valid = count <= 1
            elif token.text == "substr"
                valid = count == 2 or count == 3
            elif token.text == "index"
                valid = count == 2
            elif token.text == "split"
                valid = (count == 2 or count == 3) and parser.program.expressions[arguments[1]].kind == "name"
            elif token.text == "sprintf"
                valid = count >= 1
            else
                valid = count == 1
            if not valid
                fail(&parser, token.position)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("call", token.position, parser.scope, token.text, arguments, flag = builtin))
    if token.text == "$"
        ignored := take(&parser)
        child := if text(parser) == "++" or text(parser) == "--" then parse_prefix(&parser, suppress) else parse_atom(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("field", token.position, parser.scope, children = [child]))
    if token.text == "("
        ignored := take(&parser)
        children := expression_list(&parser, false)
        ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
        if #children == 1
            return add_expr(&parser, Expr("parentheses", token.position, parser.scope, children = children))
        ignored = expect(&parser, "in")
        name_token := read_name(&parser)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("member", token.position, parser.scope, name_token.text, children, name_position = name_token.position))
    if token.text == "getline"
        ignored := take(&parser)
        target := if peek(parser).kind == "name" or text(parser) == "$" then parse_lvalue(&parser, suppress) else -1
        source := -1
        if text(parser) == "<"
            ignored = take(&parser)
            source = parse_atom(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("getline", token.position, parser.scope, children = [target, source]))
    fail(&parser, token.position)
    return -1

int parse_postfix(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    if text(parser) == "++" or text(parser) == "--"
        return parse_prefix(&parser, suppress)
    child := parse_atom(&parser, suppress)
    if not parser.failed and parser.program.expressions[child].lvalue() and (text(parser) == "++" or text(parser) == "--")
        token := take(&parser)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("increment", token.position, parser.scope, children = [child], amount = if token.text == "++" then 1 else -1))
    return child

int parse_unary(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    if parser.failed
        return -1
    if lexer.has(["!", "-", "+"], text(parser))
        token := take(&parser)
        child := parse_unary(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("unary", token.position, parser.scope, token.text, [child]))
    child := parse_postfix(&parser, suppress)
    if not parser.failed and text(parser) == "^"
        token := take(&parser)
        right := parse_unary(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("binary", token.position, parser.scope, token.text, [child, right]))
    return child

int parse_binary(Parser &parser, int minimum, bool suppress)
    left := parse_unary(&parser, suppress)
    while not parser.failed
        spelling := text(parser)
        explicit := if spelling == "||" then 1 elif spelling == "&&" then 2 elif spelling == "in" then 3 elif lexer.has(["<", "<=", "==", "!=", ">="], spelling) or (spelling == ">" and not suppress) then 4 elif spelling == "+" or spelling == "-" then 6 elif lexer.has(["*", "/", "%"], spelling) then 7 else 0
        concat := explicit == 0 and (lexer.has(["number", "string", "name", "function", "builtin"], peek(parser).kind) or lexer.has(["$", "(", "++", "--"], spelling))
        priority := if concat then 5 else explicit
        if priority == 0 or priority < minimum
            break
        lexer.Position position := peek(parser).position
        if explicit == 3
            ignored := take(&parser)
            name_token := read_name(&parser)
            left = add_expr(&parser, Expr("member", position, parser.scope, name_token.text, [left], name_position = name_token.position))
            continue
        operation := "concat"
        if not concat
            token := take(&parser)
            operation = token.text
        if operation == "||" or operation == "&&"
            newlines(&parser)
        right := parse_binary(&parser, priority + 1, suppress)
        left = add_expr(&parser, Expr("binary", position, parser.scope, operation, [left, right]))
    return left

int parse_conditional(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    condition := parse_binary(&parser, 1, suppress)
    if not parser.failed and text(parser) == "?"
        token := take(&parser)
        yes_branch := parse_conditional(&parser, suppress)
        ignored := expect(&parser, ":")
        no_branch := parse_conditional(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("conditional", token.position, parser.scope, children = [condition, yes_branch, no_branch]))
    return condition

int parse_expression(Parser &parser, bool suppress)
    left := parse_conditional(&parser, suppress)
    if not parser.failed and parser.program.expressions[left].lvalue() and lexer.has(["=", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "^="], text(parser))
        token := take(&parser)
        right := parse_expression(&parser, suppress)
        return add_expr(&parser, Expr("assignment", token.position, parser.scope, token.text, [left, right]))
    return left

int parse_block(Parser &parser)
    opening := expect(&parser, "{{")
    int[] children := []
    while not parser.failed and text(parser) != "}}"
        if peek(parser).kind == "newline" or text(parser) == ";"
            ignored := take(&parser)
        else
            children = children.append(parse_statement(&parser))
    ignored := expect(&parser, "}}")
    return add_stmt(&parser, Stmt("block", opening.position, parser.scope, children = children))

int loop_body(Parser &parser)
    newlines(&parser)
    parser.loops += 1
    body := parse_statement(&parser)
    parser.loops -= 1
    return body

int parse_statement(Parser &parser)
    token := peek(parser)
    if parser.failed
        return -1
    if token.text == "{{"
        return parse_block(&parser)
    kind := token.text
    if not lexer.has([";", "if", "while", "do", "for", "print", "printf", "delete", "next", "break", "continue", "exit", "return"], kind)
        expression_index := parse_expression(&parser)
        terminator(&parser)
        return add_stmt(&parser, Stmt("expression", token.position, parser.scope, expressions = [expression_index]))
    ignored := take(&parser)
    result := Stmt(kind, token.position, parser.scope)
    if kind == ";"
        result.kind = "empty"
        return add_stmt(&parser, result)
    if kind == "if"
        ignored = expect(&parser, "(")
        result.expressions = [parse_expression(&parser)]
        ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
        newlines(&parser)
        yes_branch := parse_statement(&parser)
        newlines(&parser)
        no_branch := -1
        if text(parser) == "else"
            ignored = take(&parser)
            newlines(&parser)
            no_branch = parse_statement(&parser)
        result.children = [yes_branch, no_branch]
        return add_stmt(&parser, result)
    if kind == "while"
        ignored = expect(&parser, "(")
        result.expressions = [parse_expression(&parser)]
        ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
        result.children = [loop_body(&parser)]
        return add_stmt(&parser, result)
    if kind == "do"
        result.children = [loop_body(&parser)]
        newlines(&parser)
        ignored = expect(&parser, "while")
        ignored = expect(&parser, "(")
        result.expressions = [parse_expression(&parser)]
        ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
    elif kind == "for"
        ignored = expect(&parser, "(")
        cursor := parser.cursor
        if cursor + 3 < int(#parser.tokens) and parser.tokens[cursor].kind == "name" and parser.tokens[cursor + 1].text == "in" and parser.tokens[cursor + 2].kind == "name" and parser.tokens[cursor + 3].text == ")"
            variable := read_name(&parser)
            ignored = take(&parser)
            array_token := read_name(&parser)
            ignored = take(&parser)
            result.kind = "forin"
            result.name = variable.text
            result.name_position = variable.position
            result.array_name = array_token.text
            result.array_position = array_token.position
            result.children = [loop_body(&parser)]
            return add_stmt(&parser, result)
        initial := if text(parser) == ";" then -1 else parse_expression(&parser)
        ignored = expect(&parser, ";")
        newlines(&parser)
        condition := if text(parser) == ";" then -1 else parse_expression(&parser)
        ignored = expect(&parser, ";")
        newlines(&parser)
        update := if text(parser) == ")" then -1 else parse_expression(&parser)
        ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
        result.expressions = [initial, condition, update]
        result.children = [loop_body(&parser)]
        return add_stmt(&parser, result)
    elif kind == "print" or kind == "printf"
        result.kind = "output"
        result.formatted = kind == "printf"
        empty := lexer.has([";", NL, "}}", ">", ">>"], text(parser))
        parenthesized := false
        if text(parser) == "("
            depth := 0
            for: parser.cursor <= cursor < int(#parser.tokens)
                if parser.tokens[cursor].text == "("
                    depth += 1
                elif parser.tokens[cursor].text == ")"
                    depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0
                        parenthesized = cursor + 1 < int(#parser.tokens) and (lexer.has([";", NL, "}}", ">", ">>"], parser.tokens[cursor + 1].text) or parser.tokens[cursor + 1].kind == "end")
                        break
        if empty and result.formatted
            fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
        if not empty
            if parenthesized
                ignored = take(&parser)
                result.expressions = expression_list(&parser, false)
                ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
            else
                result.expressions = expression_list(&parser, true)
        if text(parser) == ">" or text(parser) == ">>"
            operation := take(&parser)
            result.redirect = operation.text
            result.redirect_position = operation.position
            result.destination = parse_binary(&parser, 5, false)
    elif kind == "delete"
        name_token := read_name(&parser)
        result.name = name_token.text
        result.name_position = name_token.position
        result.formatted = text(parser) == "["
        if result.formatted
            ignored = take(&parser)
            result.expressions = expression_list(&parser, false)
            ignored = expect(&parser, "]")
    elif kind == "next"
        if parser.special and parser.scope == -1
            fail(&parser, token.position)
    elif kind == "break" or kind == "continue"
        if parser.loops == 0
            fail(&parser, token.position)
    elif kind == "exit" or kind == "return"
        if kind == "return" and parser.scope == -1
            fail(&parser, token.position)
        result.expressions = [if lexer.has([";", NL, "}}"], text(parser)) then -1 else parse_expression(&parser)]
    terminator(&parser)
    return add_stmt(&parser, result)

Program parse(const lexer.Token[] tokens)
    parser := Parser(tokens)
    while not parser.failed and peek(parser).kind != "end"
        if text(parser) == ";" or peek(parser).kind == "newline"
            ignored := take(&parser)
            continue
        first := peek(parser)
        if first.text == "function"
            ignored := take(&parser)
            if peek(parser).kind != "name" and peek(parser).kind != "function"
                fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
            name_token := take(&parser)
            ignored = expect(&parser, "(")
            Parameter[] parameters := []
            if text(parser) != ")"
                while not parser.failed
                    parameter := read_name(&parser)
                    parameters = parameters.append(Parameter(parameter.text, parameter.position))
                    if text(parser) != ","
                        break
                    ignored = take(&parser)
                    newlines(&parser)
            ignored = expect(&parser, ")")
            newlines(&parser)
            parser.scope = int(#parser.program.functions)
            body := parse_block(&parser)
            parser.scope = -1
            parser.program.functions = parser.program.functions.append(Function(name_token.text, name_token.position, parameters, body))
        elif first.text == "BEGIN" or first.text == "END"
            ignored := take(&parser)
            parser.special = true
            action := parse_block(&parser)
            parser.special = false
            parser.program.rules = parser.program.rules.append(Rule(first.text, first.position, action = action))
        elif first.text == "{{"
            action := parse_block(&parser)
            parser.program.rules = parser.program.rules.append(Rule("all", first.position, action = action))
        else
            start := parse_expression(&parser)
            finish := -1
            if text(parser) == ","
                ignored := take(&parser)
                newlines(&parser)
                finish = parse_expression(&parser)
            action := -1
            if text(parser) == "{{"
                action = parse_block(&parser)
            elif text(parser) != ";" and peek(parser).kind != "newline" and peek(parser).kind != "end"
                fail(&parser, peek(parser).position)
            parser.program.rules = parser.program.rules.append(Rule(if finish == -1 then "pattern" else "range", first.position, start, finish, action))
    return parser.program

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class Assignment(string name, string value)
class Operand(string kind, string name, value := "", file_index := -1)
class FileCount(string name, records := 0)
class Arguments(Assignment[] options := [], Operand[] operands := [], FileCount[] files := [])
class Output(string name, text := "", writes := 0, open := false)
class Input(string name, string[] lines := [], position := 0, reads := 0, opened := false, open := false, exists := false)
class State(stdout := "", writes := 0, Output[] outputs := [], Input[] inputs := [])
class Line(int status, text := "")

bool valid_file(string text)
    if text == "" or text.starts_with(".")
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        if not lexer.letter(character) and not lexer.digit(character) and not "._-".contains(character)
            return false
    return true

string[] lines_of(string text)
    if text == ""
        return []
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

string[] | none read_data(string name)
    if not valid_file(name)
        return none
    bool exists := file.exists("input/{name}")
    if not exists
        return none
    bool directory := file.is_directory("input/{name}")
    if directory
        return none
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/{name}"))
    return lines_of(text)

Assignment | none assignment(string text)
    for: index < int(#text)
        if text[index] == "="
            return Assignment(text[0:<index], text[index + 1:<int(#text)])
    return none

bool variable(string text)
    if text == "" or (not lexer.letter(text[0]) and text[0] != "_")
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        if not lexer.letter(text[index]) and not lexer.digit(text[index]) and text[index] != "_"
            return false
    return true

Arguments arguments(string text)
    result := Arguments()
    for line := lines_of(text)[]
        if line.starts_with("-F ")
            result.options = result.options.append(Assignment("FS", line[3:<int(#line)]))
        elif line.starts_with("-v ")
            match assignment(line[3:<int(#line)])
                Assignment found
                    result.options = result.options.append(found)
                none
                    continue
        else
            assigned := false
            match assignment(line)
                Assignment found
                    if variable(found.name)
                        result.operands = result.operands.append(Operand("assignment", found.name, found.value))
                        assigned = true
                none
                    assigned = false
            if not assigned
                result.operands = result.operands.append(Operand("file", line, file_index = int(#result.files)))
                result.files = result.files.append(FileCount(line))
    return result

void output(State &state, string | none name, bool append, string text)
    target := ""
    match name
        string found
            target = found
        none
            state.stdout += text
            state.writes += 1
            return
    index := -1
    for: candidate < int(#state.outputs)
        if state.outputs[candidate].name == target
            index = candidate
            break
    if index == -1
        index = int(#state.outputs)
        state.outputs = state.outputs.append(Output(target))
    if not state.outputs[index].open
        state.outputs[index].open = true
        if not append
            state.outputs[index].text = ""
    state.outputs[index].text += text
    state.outputs[index].writes += 1

Line getline(State &state, string name)
    index := -1
    for: candidate < int(#state.inputs)
        if state.inputs[candidate].name == name
            index = candidate
            break
    if index == -1
        index = int(#state.inputs)
        state.inputs = state.inputs.append(Input(name))
    if not state.inputs[index].open
        state.inputs[index].position = 0
        match read_data(name)
            string[] lines
                state.inputs[index].lines = lines
                state.inputs[index].open = true
                state.inputs[index].opened = true
                state.inputs[index].exists = true
            none
                state.inputs[index].exists = false
    if not state.inputs[index].exists
        return Line(-1)
    position := state.inputs[index].position
    if position == int(#state.inputs[index].lines)
        return Line(0)
    state.inputs[index].position += 1
    state.inputs[index].reads += 1
    return Line(1, state.inputs[index].lines[position])

int close(State &state, string name)
    closed := false
    for: index < int(#state.outputs)
        if state.outputs[index].name == name
            closed = closed or state.outputs[index].open
            state.outputs[index].open = false
    for: index < int(#state.inputs)
        if state.inputs[index].name == name
            closed = closed or state.inputs[index].open
            state.inputs[index].open = false
    return if closed then 0 else -1

void save(const State state)
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    writer1 := file.write("output/stdout.txt")
    .writer1(state.stdout)
    for entry := state.outputs[]
        writer2 := file.write("output/{entry.name}")
        .writer2(entry.text)

import collections
import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

int text_number(string text);
string quote(string text);

class Value(kind := "uninitialized", text := "", amount := 0)
    int number()
        return if kind == "string" then text_number(text) else amount

    string string_value()
        return if kind == "number" then "{amount}" else text

    bool truth()
        return if kind == "string" then text != "" else amount != 0

    string display()
        if kind == "number"
            return "{amount}"
        if kind == "uninitialized"
            return "(uninitialized)"
        return quote(text) + (if kind == "numeric" then " (strnum)" else "")

class Fields(record := Value("string"), Value[] values := [])

bool whitespace(string character)
    return character == " " or character == HT or character == NL

int text_number(string text)
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#text) and whitespace(text[cursor])
        cursor += 1
    negative := cursor < int(#text) and text[cursor] == "-"
    if cursor < int(#text) and (text[cursor] == "+" or text[cursor] == "-")
        cursor += 1
    amount := 0
    while cursor < int(#text) and lexer.digit(text[cursor])
        amount = amount * 10 + text[cursor].codepoints()[0] - 48
        cursor += 1
    return if negative then -amount else amount

Value input_value(string text)
    start := 0
    finish := int(#text)
    while start < finish and whitespace(text[start])
        start += 1
    while finish > start and whitespace(text[finish - 1])
        finish -= 1
    if start < finish and (text[start] == "+" or text[start] == "-")
        start += 1
    numeric := start < finish
    for: start <= index < finish
        numeric = numeric and lexer.digit(text[index])
    return if numeric then Value("numeric", text, text_number(text)) else Value("string", text)

int compare(const Value first, const Value second)
    if first.kind != "string" and second.kind != "string"
        a := first.number()
        b := second.number()
        return if a < b then -1 elif a > b then 1 else 0
    a := first.string_value()
    b := second.string_value()
    return if collections.lex_compare(a.codepoints(), b.codepoints()) < 0 then -1 elif collections.lex_compare(a.codepoints(), b.codepoints()) > 0 then 1 else 0

string quote(string text)
    string result := DQ
    octal := "01234567"
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        int code := character.codepoints()[0]
        if character == DQ or character == "\"
            result += "\" + character
        elif character == NL
            result += "\n"
        elif character == HT
            result += "\t"
        elif 32 <= code <= 126
            result += character
        else
            result += "\" + octal[code / 64] + octal[(code / 8) % 8] + octal[code % 8]
    return result + DQ

string[] split_text(string text, string separator)
    string[] pieces := []
    if separator == " "
        cursor := 0
        while cursor < int(#text)
            while cursor < int(#text) and whitespace(text[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            start := cursor
            while cursor < int(#text) and not whitespace(text[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            if cursor > start
                pieces = pieces.append(text[start:<cursor])
        return pieces
    if separator == ""
        for: index < int(#text)
            pieces = pieces.append(text[index])
        return pieces
    return if text == "" then [] else text.split(separator)

int | none integer_key(string text)
    if text == "0"
        return 0
    start := if text.starts_with("-") then 1 else 0
    if start == int(#text) or text[start].codepoints()[0] < 49 or text[start].codepoints()[0] > 57
        return none
    for: start <= index < int(#text)
        if not lexer.digit(text[index])
            return none
    return int(text)

bool key_less(string first, string second)
    match integer_key(first)
        int a
            match integer_key(second)
                int b
                    return a < b
                none
                    return true
        none
            match integer_key(second)
                int b
                    return false
                none
                    return collections.lex_compare(first.codepoints(), second.codepoints()) < 0

string[] key_order(string[] keys)
    for: index < int(#keys)
        key := keys[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0 and key_less(key, keys[cursor - 1])
            keys[cursor] = keys[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        keys[cursor] = key
    return keys

void set_record(Fields &fields, string text, string separator)
    fields.record = input_value(text)
    fields.values = []
    for piece := split_text(text, separator)[]
        fields.values = fields.values.append(input_value(piece))

Value get_field(const Fields fields, int index)
    if index == 0
        return fields.record
    return if index <= int(#fields.values) then fields.values[index - 1] else Value()

void rebuild(Fields &fields, string separator)
    string[] pieces := []
    for value := fields.values[]
        pieces = pieces.append(value.string_value())
    fields.record = input_value(pieces.join(separator))

void assign_field(Fields &fields, int index, const Value value, string fs, string ofs)
    if index == 0
        set_record(&fields, value.string_value(), fs)
        return
    while int(#fields.values) < index
        fields.values = fields.values.append(Value("string"))
    fields.values[index - 1] = value
    rebuild(&fields, ofs)

void change_nf(Fields &fields, int size, string ofs)
    if size < int(#fields.values)
        fields.values = fields.values[0:<size]
    while int(#fields.values) < size
        fields.values = fields.values.append(Value("string"))
    rebuild(&fields, ofs)
